topics.description: Former FBI Director Robert Mueller, who led the investigation into Russian interference in the 2016 US presidential election, has died at the age of 81. This event is trending due to Mueller's significant role in American politics and the ongoing impact of his investigation.

The Feeding Our Future scam, involving $800,000 in fraudulent NDIS and childcare funds, continues to trend as more guilty pleas are entered. This story remains hot due to the scale of the fraud and ongoing legal proceedings.
topics.reason: Ongoing legal developments and large sum of money involved
